snippet.title: PARMAN – Psychological Horror Game Reveal Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Welcome to PARMAN, a psychological horror game that traps you inside an abandoned school filled with secrets, darkness, and memories that refuse to die.

You are trapped.
There are no clear hints.
No one is coming to help.

Your only chance is to search for hidden keys, unlock forbidden rooms, and uncover the truth buried for decades—before the school claims you like the others.

🔑 Gameplay Highlights:
• Explore a haunted school with chilling details
• Solve challenging puzzles and key-hunting sequences
• Intense atmosphere with minimal guidance
• A dark story of bullying, fear, and forgotten tragedy
• Immersive sound & visual design for maximum tension

🗝️ Will you uncover what really happened here?
Or will you become the next name lost in this place?

🎮 PARMAN
Releasing on Steam – December 12, 2025
